step:start.text: New face on the board. Pick a handle you can live with, chummer. Your government name? Keep it in a lead box.
Second the lead box. I've seen SINs sold for less than a soykaf.

step:priorities.text: Five letters, A through E, and every one of 'em costs you something. Welcome to the shadows.
Put Resources on E and you'll be eating Nutrisoy out of a dumpster behind the Stuffer Shack. Ask me how I know.
Put Magic on A and the street will smell it on you before you open your mouth. Worth it.

step:metatype.text: Pick your meat. You'll be stuck in it a while.
And every bouncer from here to Tacoma will treat you like it.

step:magic.text: Awakened? Then hear this: the drain doesn't care how pretty your spell looks.
Totem or tradition, choose like your life depends on it. It will.

step:attributes.text: Body keeps you breathing. Quickness keeps you out of the way. Nobody ever died of too much Willpower.
And Willpower keeps you from doing something stupid. Mostly.

step:skills.text: Can't shoot, can't talk, can't drive? Then you'd better be able to run. Fast.
Etiquette is the cheapest armor in the Sprawl. Nobody buys it.

step:edges.text: Everybody's got a flaw. The smart ones know which one will get 'em killed.
And the dumb ones put it on a T-shirt.

step:resources.text: Nuyen in your pocket at the start is the most nuyen you'll ever have. Spend it like it's your last.
So spend it like you'll never see that much again. You probably won't.

step:contacts.text: Your fixer is not your friend. Your fixer is your fixer. Learn the difference before you learn it the hard way.
Your bartender, though. Tip your bartender.

step:lifestyle.text: Low lifestyle: you'll learn which neighbours to trust. Squatter: you'll learn which ones to run from.
High lifestyle: you'll learn which neighbours call security on you.

step:finish.text: Board's open. Don't make me write your obituary on it.
Frag it, I'll write it. I've got a template.

step:concept.text: Who are you when the lights go out? Write it down before someone else writes it for you.
Concept first, chrome later. Every good runner I knew had a reason.
A face for a portrait, a name for the street. Make them both forgettable or both unforgettable.
No middle ground. The middle ground gets you remembered by the wrong people.

step:card.text: Print the card. Datapads die. Paper only dies if you set it on fire.
Which I have done. On purpose. Long story.
One page, everything you need at the table. Anything else is homework.
Laminate it. Soykaf rings are not a dice modifier.

step:karma.text: Good Karma, chummer. Spend it on what kept you alive, not on what looks good.
I spent mine on Etiquette. Still alive. Coincidence? Probably not.
Karma Pool's the closest thing to luck we've got. Don't waste it on rolling for a parking space.
In this city? Parking is a combat encounter.

step:nuyen.text: Every purchase is a ledger line. Every ledger line is evidence. Pay cash.
Pay cash, keep receipts. Contradiction? Welcome to the shadows.
Sold it to a fence? You got a third of what it's worth and a story. Keep the story.
The fence gets the rest. And your face.

step:condition.text: Mark the boxes honestly. The street doc will count them anyway.
Ten boxes. I've filled eleven. Don't ask.
Stun heals by morning. Physical heals by paying someone. Plan accordingly.
Or by knowing a shaman who owes you. Cheaper, worse bedside manner.
